research_question: Can targeted clarification from a cold start match or exceed no-ask generation from a broad PDR-style persona?

question_budget.eligible_questions: high-impact, low-evidence, user-owned variables whose alternatives change sources, shortlist, recommendation, or risk boundary

outcomes.primary: P_official: unmodified exact-pair PDR criteria, weights, 0-10 criterion scores, and two-level weighted aggregation
outcomes.co_primary_mechanism: P_HI: human-approved counterfactual high-impact decision-leaf pass rate
secondary: P_strict: anchor-calibrated rescore of the same PDR criteria, explicitly not the official P-score
token, search, fetch, latency, and cost

task_policy.development_case: PDR-T35 x User8; prior score observed, excluded from clean confirmation
task_policy.confirmatory_holdouts: minimum two exact PDR task-persona pairs selected before generation by the pressure gate

success_rule.cross_model_direction: CA > FN in at least 3 of 4 model families
success_rule.quality_guard: shared Q and R are non-inferior under a frozen margin
success_rule.budget_guard: all cells receive the same research budget; clarification answer tokens are logged separately
success_rule.task_level_uncertainty: cluster or bootstrap at task level; judge repeats are not independent samples

anti_gaming: freeze task, persona, current-state ledger, criteria, weights, scorer, and exclusions before outputs
retain symmetric current-state alternatives and matched/swapped scoring
do not select tasks because an observed run produced CA > FN
do not call P_strict or P_HI the official PDR P-score
do not force a stable ranking; report violations
